top_signals.title: Brent Briefly Hits $96 After Trump Says U.S. Has No Need for Iran Deal
top_signals.summary: President Donald Trump declared Thursday that the United States no longer needs a deal with Iran, just three days after suggesting the eight-month war was nearing its end. Oil prices promptly jumped, adding another round of volatility to a market that has spent November reacting to shifting expectations for peace. "We don't need a deal with Iran. Those days have long since passed," Trump wrote on Truth Social, adding that Washington had control of Iran's money and the Strait of Hormuz. The remarks marked a sharp departure from Monday, when Trump…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Lula Eyes Measures to Boost Fiscal Adjustment to $14 Billion
top_signals.summary: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva’s government is preparing additional budget measures to improve fiscal results next year, stepping up efforts to shore up public finances amid investor concerns about rising public debt, according to a person familiar with the discussions.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.
